purpose: Freeze the authority rule before any external G1/G2/G3 commitment batch is accepted.
cryptographic_completeness_requirements: Exactly three generation receipts are required: G1, G2, G3.
Every generation receipt must self-hash correctly and have all_cases_passed=true with passed_cases=case_count>0.
All receipts must bind to the same commitment batch SHA-256, formal freeze SHA-256, batch_id, and custodian_id.
Each generation receipt challenge_id must equal the corresponding precommitted challenge_id and all three challenge IDs must be unique.
The formal freeze must bind the exact commitment batch and must state that all G1/G2/G3 commitments were present before G1 began.
independence_requirements: Three-generation cryptographic success is necessary but not sufficient for independent authority.
A distinct GitHub submission account is useful provenance but is not by itself proof that the account is independently controlled.
A repository-local provenance JSON, even if it says verified=true and names a distinct actor or URL, is evidence material only and cannot confer independent authority.
The candidate repository, its workflows, the repository owner, ChatGPT, and ARTE are not permitted to self-certify E4 independent custody.
Repository-local aggregate tooling may only emit an EXTERNAL_AUTHORITY_CANDIDATE after cryptographic, semantic, stage-order, and provenance consistency checks.

E4 authorization requires an adjudication made outside the candidate/user/ChatGPT/ARTE authority boundary by an actually independent evaluator who directly controls or verifies the relevant external custody evidence.
The external adjudication must publicly bind the commitment batch, formal freeze, three generation receipts, and the evaluator's own authority/provenance.
Until such an external adjudication exists and is independently inspectable, E4_independent_custody_authorized remains false.
stage_separation_requirements: Hidden plaintext, OTP keys, sensor bits, and targets must remain outside the candidate boundary until their specified reveal stage.
Public packet reveal occurs only after formal candidate freeze.
Sensor bits are returned only after question outputs are frozen and the custodian response binds the exact question-output hash.
OTP keys and targets are revealed only after prediction outputs are frozen and the reveal binds the exact prediction-output hash.
